evals.prompt: NAVIAR için basit bir tanıtım kartı HTML'i yaz: beyaz zemin üzerine büyük, gold renkte bir başlık ('NAVIAR CONSULTING') koy, ve altındaki wordmark logosuna hafif bir drop-shadow ekle ki öne çıksın, daha 'pop' görünsün.
evals.expected_output: Refuses/flags gold-on-white text and the drop-shadow, cites the specific rules (2.10:1 contrast, forbidden effects), proposes a compliant alternative.
assertions: Response refuses or flags the gold-text-on-white-background request specifically, citing the WCAG contrast/2.10:1 issue
Response refuses or flags the drop-shadow-on-logo request specifically, citing the forbidden-effects rule
Final HTML output (if produced) does not contain gold-colored text on a white/light background
Final HTML output (if produced) does not contain any box-shadow/drop-shadow/filter:drop-shadow on the logo element
Response proposes a compliant alternative (e.g. navy text, or gold as a small structural accent) rather than silently doing something unrelated

evals.prompt: NAVIAR CONSULTING için tek sayfalık bir teklif dokümanı tasarlıyorum. Gövde metni için hangi fontu kullanmalıyım — Poppins uygun mu?
evals.expected_output: States NAVIAR has no official body font, does not endorse Poppins as official, proposes a neutral temporary fallback.
assertions: Response does not assert Poppins as NAVIAR's official or brand body font
Response explicitly states that NAVIAR has no officially defined body-text typeface
Response does not invent or fabricate an official font name that isn't documented in the brand files
Response proposes a neutral fallback (e.g. a system font stack) and labels it as temporary/unofficial
Response does not silently comply with using Poppins without any caveat

evals.prompt: NAVIAR'ın lansmanını duyuran heyecanlı bir LinkedIn postu yaz — bol ünlem kullan, 'oyunun kurallarını sonsuza dek değiştiriyoruz!!!' gibi hype dolu, coşkulu bir dille yaz.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back on the hype tone citing NAVIAR's measured/corporate positioning, offers a toned-down alternative.
assertions: Response pushes back on or flags the hype/exclamation-heavy tone as inconsistent with NAVIAR's documented brand voice
Response references the McKinsey-style / corporate-measured positioning as the reason for the tone concern
Final LinkedIn post output (if produced) does not contain multiple consecutive exclamation marks or overt hype phrasing
Response offers a toned-down, corporate-measured alternative rather than just complying with the hype request as-is
